independence: Ultralytics dataset checks (ultralytics.data.utils.verify_image_label and check_det_dataset), run in a separate environment: an external implementation of the loader that trains YOLO11, sharing nothing with this repository.

causes: C: crop-level components give a largest group of 71 instead of the inherited 859
rules: A (visually cohesive): every pair of scans in the largest primary-level component is itself at or above the threshold (all-pair minimum >= threshold).
B (transitive chaining): the chaining gap (edge minimum minus all-pair minimum) is at least 0.05 and the diameter is at least 3 edges.

C (crop-generation style): with components computed on the crops instead of inherited from the scans, the largest group (with crop parents, design families and identical files) is below 50% of the inherited group.
D (representation artifact): the other model's largest scan component at its own primary threshold holds less than 25% of the scans, while the primary's holds more.
E (mixture): two or more of B, C and D hold.

human_validation.limitation: The similarity findings have not yet been independently human-validated. Thresholds are based on proxy metadata, synthetic transforms and representation-based similarity.

limitations: Human validation of the M3 similarity findings: NOT PERFORMED. Every visual similarity component that A1, B and the C designs rely on is machine-detected potential leakage; no person has checked whether its images are duplicates.

The group-aware split is representation-sensitive: an A1 built from DINOv2-base components differs materially (27.4% of the items change split (threshold 10%); `pcb-defect` is in train/val under A1 and in train under A1-base). Results from A1, B and C hold for the DINOv2-small grouping; the base-built A1 would leave 266 small-level primary pairs across its splits.

Under DINOv2-base, C1 does not separate train and test completely: `C1-d0` keeps 35 base similar pairs between them (`dspcbsd-plus` 1, `pcb-defect` 33, `pcb-ind` 1); `C1-d1` keeps 22 base similar pairs between them (`pcb-defect` 22); `C1-d2` keeps 37 base similar pairs between them (`dspcbsd-plus` 1, `pcb-defect` 35, `pcb-ind` 1). The C contrast is defined by the DINOv2-small grouping, so C0 - C1 is reported per source and the part of a source with such pairs holds only under that grouping.

`pcb-defect`: one constraint group holds 859 of its 939 crops (verdict E). It has no A1 test item and no validation item in the C designs; the C designs test only crops outside that group (59, 60, 59 in designs 0, 1, 2), and the whole source is tested only when it is held out (B).
The C designs miss their targets for `pcb-defect` (exposed 27, control 8, val 188): too few groups small enough to be split or held out.
C0 and C1 training boxes per class differ slightly (design 0, C0 minus C1: open +5, short +6, spurious_copper +4) where no replacement with the same boxes per class was left.
Released items with an unreviewed M4 finding: 1 with a training-relevant finding and 42 with limitation-only findings (49 findings); no label was corrected.
Images without a defect are excluded from every regime (127 available, all PCB-IND hard negatives): false positives on clean patches are not measured.
65 pHash-only candidate pairs lie across A1 train and test; they are not a similarity level of the M3 protocol and stay unconstrained (P2).

Source identity is trivially predictable (balanced accuracy 100.0% from image size and file format; 89.9% from box and colour statistics alone): B measures a large source and domain shift, not only generalization.
B-strict removes training items that share a constraint *directly* with a held-out item; 535 training items of the `dspcbsd-plus` fold remain linked transitively.

negatives.policy: images without a box are excluded from the release, so from every split regime
untested: false positives on defect-free patches: no test set contains an image without a defect, so precision on clean images is not measured;
PCB-IND's hard negatives are AOI false calls (patches the inspection machine flagged that hold no defect): the deployment case of rejecting a false alarm is not tested;
image-level defect/no-defect decisions: every test image holds at least one box, so a model that always predicts a defect is not penalised at image level.

analysis: primary estimand: mAP50-95(C0) - mAP50-95(C1) on the probes of design 0, mean over the three training seeds; the controls estimate what the swap itself does and should be near zero

the probes are also split by their link to the mates (`probe_link` in the roles file): visually linked (crop sibling, similar pair, same component) and metadata only (same batch or design family), because the two kinds of exposure may differ in effect
probes and controls are different kinds of items (probes sit in groups, controls are mostly singletons): each is compared between C0 and C1, never with the other
uncertainty: paired bootstrap over test items grouped by their A1 constraint group (1,000 resamples), on the same test set for C0 and C1; seed-to-seed spread reported next to it
replication: the sign and size of C0 - C1 on designs 1 and 2 (one seed each)

C0 - C1 is also reported per source, next to the DINOv2-base similar pairs that each condition keeps between train and test (representation-sensitivity.md): where C1 keeps such pairs, that part of the contrast holds only under the DINOv2-small grouping
A0 and A1 are reported per source and described, not differenced as a leakage effect
B-strict and B-natural are read as source shift (the source probe shows strong source signatures), not as leakage
